title: set --depends-on '' stores an empty-string dependency instead of clearing
findings_note: dogfooding S02 (greenfield): 'slicer set ID --depends-on ""' sets depends_on=[''], a phantom 'depends on unknown id ' that fails check/verify. Empty --depends-on should clear to []. import/add may share the parse. Bug.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
`--depends-on` is `action="append"`, so `slicer set ID --depends-on ""` produced
`depends_on=[""]` — a phantom "depends on unknown id " that fails `check`/`verify`. Found in the
S02 greenfield trial. The same path affects `add` and any list field.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- src/slicer/ops.py: a `_clean` helper drops empty/whitespace entries from list fields (trees,
  flags, depends_on) in `add` and `set_fields_many`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Normalize repeatable list fields by dropping empty entries wherever they are accepted, so an
empty `--depends-on` (or `--tree`) clears to `[]` rather than storing `['']`.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
`set ID --depends-on ""` clears to `[]`; a mix keeps real ids and drops the empty; `add
--depends-on ""` stores none; `verify` stays clean. Focused ops tests + the unit suite.
